content: The recommended dosage of trimethoprim for pediatric patients diagnosed with acute otitis media is 10 mg per kilogram of body weight per 24 hours. This total daily dose should be administered in two divided doses, given every 12 hours, over a course of 10 days. For uncomplicated urinary tract infections in adults, the standard oral dosage is either 100 mg (equivalent to 10 mL) every 12 hours or 200 mg (equivalent to 20 mL) every 24 hours. Both regimens should be continued for a duration of 10 days. In patients with impaired renal function, the use of trimethoprim is not recommended if the creatinine clearance is less than 15 mL per minute. For patients with a creatinine clearance between 15 and 30 mL per minute, the dosage should be reduced to half of the standard dose recommended for individuals of the same age with normal renal function.
